basic_profile.bio: A car enthusiast from Texas, fascinated by all things automotive and tech. When not cruising in my G35 or hitting off-road trails in my Jeep, I dabble in gaming, especially enjoying ARK and other survival games. Recently got into streaming and experimenting with new gaming peripherals, hence my interest in SteelSeries. I work as a junior IT technician, and I'm in a long-term relationship. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in automotive mechanics and tech. Grew up in a family of car enthusiasts and learned the ropes from an early age. My IT knowledge stems from a mix of community college courses and hands-on experience at my current job.
